effect:hypericum|anticoagulantes: Significantly reduces plasma levels of warfarin, increasing the risk of thrombosis and cardiovascular events.
mech:hypericum|anticoagulantes: Potent induction of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, and P-glycoprotein. Accelerates warfarin metabolism.
effect:hypericum|isrs: Risk of serotonin syndrome (agitation, confusion, tachycardia, hyperthermia). Potentially fatal.
mech:hypericum|isrs: St. John's wort inhibits serotonin reuptake. Combined with an SSRI it produces excess synaptic serotonin.
effect:hypericum|imao: Extreme risk of serotonin crisis. Contraindicated combination.
mech:hypericum|imao: Both increase serotonin levels through complementary mechanisms: MAOIs prevent degradation, St. John's wort inhibits reuptake.
effect:hypericum|anticonceptivos: Reduces the effectiveness of oral contraceptives. Risk of unintended pregnancy.
mech:hypericum|anticonceptivos: CYP3A4 induction accelerates the metabolism of ethinyl estradiol and progestogens. Reduces plasma concentrations by up to 50%.
effect:hypericum|inmunosupresores: Drastically reduces levels of cyclosporine and tacrolimus. Risk of transplant rejection.
mech:hypericum|inmunosupresores: Potent induction of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein. Levels may drop 50-70%.
effect:hypericum|antirretrovirales: Reduces levels of protease inhibitors (indinavir, ritonavir) by up to 57%. Risk of virologic failure.
mech:hypericum|antirretrovirales: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein induction accelerates ARV metabolism.
effect:hypericum|estatinas: Reduces the effectiveness of simvastatin and atorvastatin. Poorer cholesterol control.
mech:hypericum|estatinas: CYP3A4 induction accelerates the metabolism of statins metabolized by this pathway.
effect:hypericum|benzodiacepinas: May reduce levels of alprazolam and midazolam. Reduced anxiolytic effect.
mech:hypericum|benzodiacepinas: CYP3A4 induction accelerates the metabolism of benzodiazepines metabolized by this pathway.
effect:hypericum|digoxina: Reduces blood levels of digoxin. Risk of loss of heart rhythm control.
mech:hypericum|digoxina: P-glycoprotein induction in the intestine reduces digoxin absorption.
effect:hypericum|quimioterapia: Reduces the effectiveness of multiple chemotherapeutic agents (irinotecan, imatinib, docetaxel). Risk of treatment failure.
mech:hypericum|quimioterapia: CYP3A4 and P-gp induction accelerates elimination. Irinotecan levels may fall by 42%.
effect:hypericum|anticonvulsivantes: May reduce levels of phenytoin and carbamazepine.
effect:hypericum|opioides: Reduces levels of methadone and oxycodone. Risk of withdrawal syndrome or uncontrolled pain.
effect:hypericum|isrsn: Risk of serotonin syndrome, same as with SSRIs.
mech:hypericum|isrsn: Serotonin reuptake inhibition added to the effect of venlafaxine/duloxetine.
effect:hypericum|tiroideos: May reduce levothyroxine levels. Risk of subclinical hypothyroidism.
mech:hypericum|tiroideos: Induction of hepatic enzymes that metabolize T4.
effect:curcuma|anticoagulantes: Increases bleeding risk by potentiating the anticoagulant effect of warfarin.
mech:curcuma|anticoagulantes: Curcumin inhibits platelet aggregation and inhibits CYP2C9 (the main metabolic pathway of warfarin), increasing its levels.
effect:curcuma|antiplaquetarios: Potentiates the antiplatelet effect. Increased bleeding risk during surgical procedures.
mech:curcuma|antiplaquetarios: Curcumin inhibits thromboxane synthase and reduces platelet aggregation via a pathway independent of aspirin.
effect:curcuma|antidiabeticos: May potentiate the hypoglycemic effect of metformin and other antidiabetics. Risk of hypoglycemia.
mech:curcuma|antidiabeticos: Curcumin improves insulin sensitivity and reduces hepatic gluconeogenesis.
effect:curcuma|estatinas: May increase levels of statins metabolized by CYP3A4.
mech:curcuma|estatinas: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition in vitro. Clinical relevance uncertain.
effect:curcuma|omeprazol: May increase omeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP2C19.
effect:curcuma|quimioterapia: Dual interaction: may potentiate some agents (doxorubicin) but reduce others (cyclophosphamide).
mech:curcuma|quimioterapia: Curcumin modulates multiple pathways (NF-κB, Nrf2) that affect tumor sensitivity. It may also affect metabolism via CYP3A4.
effect:ginkgo|anticoagulantes: Significantly increases bleeding risk. Cerebral and ocular hemorrhages have been reported.
mech:ginkgo|anticoagulantes: Ginkgolides inhibit platelet-activating factor (PAF). Synergistic effect with anticoagulants.
effect:ginkgo|antiplaquetarios: Additive bleeding risk with aspirin and clopidogrel. Spontaneous hemorrhage reported.
mech:ginkgo|antiplaquetarios: PAF inhibition by ginkgolides + platelet inhibition by aspirin/clopidogrel = synergistic bleeding.
effect:ginkgo|anticonvulsivantes: May reduce levels of phenytoin and valproic acid. Risk of seizures.
mech:ginkgo|anticonvulsivantes: Ginkgotoxin (4'-O-methylpyridoxine) is a vitamin B6 antagonist that may lower the seizure threshold. In addition, ginkgo induces CYP2C19.
mech:ginkgo|aines: PAF inhibition + COX inhibition by NSAIDs = increased GI bleeding risk.
effect:ginkgo|isrs: Reports of bleeding with the fluoxetine + ginkgo combination.
mech:ginkgo|isrs: Ginkgo's platelet inhibition adds to the antiserotonergic platelet effect of SSRIs.
effect:ginkgo|antidiabeticos: May alter insulin levels. Monitor glucose.
mech:ginkgo|antidiabeticos: Ginkgo may affect pancreatic insulin secretion.
effect:ginkgo|teofilina: May reduce theophylline levels by inducing CYP1A2.
effect:ajo|anticoagulantes: Increases bleeding risk. Reports of elevated INR with warfarin.
mech:ajo|anticoagulantes: Garlic inhibits platelet aggregation (ajoene, allicin) and may inhibit CYP2C9.
effect:ajo|antiplaquetarios: Additive antiplatelet effect. Increased bleeding risk.
mech:ajo|antiplaquetarios: Ajoene and allicin inhibit platelet aggregation via independent pathways.
effect:ajo|antirretrovirales: Reduces saquinavir levels by 51%. Risk of virologic failure.
mech:ajo|antirretrovirales: Garlic induces CYP3A4 and intestinal P-glycoprotein.
effect:ajo|antihipertensivos: May potentiate the hypotensive effect. Risk of hypotension in treated patients.
mech:ajo|antihipertensivos: Garlic has its own vasodilatory effect (production of H2S and NO).
effect:ajo|antidiabeticos: May slightly potentiate the hypoglycemic effect.
mech:ajo|antidiabeticos: Organosulfur compounds in garlic improve insulin secretion.
effect:ginseng|anticoagulantes: Reduces the effect of warfarin. A decrease in INR has been reported.
mech:ginseng|anticoagulantes: Possible CYP2C9 induction or antagonism by ginsenosides with procoagulant activity.
effect:ginseng|antidiabeticos: May potentiate the hypoglycemic effect. Risk of hypoglycemia.
mech:ginseng|antidiabeticos: Ginsenosides improve insulin sensitivity and stimulate glucose uptake.
effect:ginseng|imao: Reports of headache, insomnia, and mania with the combination.
mech:ginseng|imao: Ginsenosides have CNS-stimulant activity that is potentiated by MAOIs.
effect:ginseng|isrs: Risk of mild serotonin syndrome. Reports of mania.
effect:ginseng|antihipertensivos: May antagonize or potentiate the hypotensive effect depending on the dose.
mech:ginseng|antihipertensivos: Ginsenosides have biphasic effects on blood pressure.
effect:valeriana|benzodiacepinas: Potentiates benzodiazepine sedation. Risk of excessive drowsiness.
mech:valeriana|benzodiacepinas: Valerenic acid acts as a partial agonist at the GABA-A receptor, the same target as benzodiazepines.
mech:valeriana|opioides: GABAergic effect adds to the central depressant effect of opioids.
effect:valeriana|anestesicos: May prolong anesthetic sedation. Discontinuation 2 weeks before surgery is recommended.
mech:valeriana|anestesicos: Additive GABAergic effect with general anesthetics.
effect:equinacea|inmunosupresores: May antagonize the immunosuppressive effect. Risk of transplant rejection.
mech:equinacea|inmunosupresores: Echinacea stimulates the immune system (activates macrophages and NK cells), counteracting pharmacologic immunosuppression.
effect:equinacea|antifungicos: May increase ketoconazole and itraconazole levels.
mech:equinacea|antifungicos: Inhibition of hepatic CYP3A4 (but induction of intestinal CYP3A4 — net effect variable).
effect:equinacea|corticosteroides: May reduce the efficacy of immunosuppressive corticosteroids.
effect:kava|benzodiacepinas: Dangerous potentiation of sedation. Coma reported.
mech:kava|benzodiacepinas: Kavalactones potentiate GABAergic transmission by a mechanism similar to benzodiazepines.
effect:kava|opioides: Potentiation of sedation and respiratory depression.
effect:kava|estatinas: Kava is hepatotoxic. Combined with statins it increases the risk of liver damage.
mech:kava|estatinas: Additive hepatotoxicity. Both compounds are metabolized by CYP3A4 and CYP2D6.
effect:kava|anestesicos: May prolong anesthetic sedation. Discontinue 2 weeks before surgery.
effect:jengibre|anticoagulantes: May potentiate the anticoagulant effect. Increased bleeding risk.
mech:jengibre|anticoagulantes: Gingerols inhibit thromboxane synthase and platelet aggregation.
effect:jengibre|antidiabeticos: May slightly potentiate the hypoglycemic effect.
mech:jengibre|antidiabeticos: Ginger improves insulin sensitivity in animal studies.
effect:jengibre|antihipertensivos: May slightly potentiate the hypotensive effect.
mech:jengibre|antihipertensivos: Weak calcium channel blockade by gingerols.
effect:berberina|antidiabeticos: Significantly potentiates the hypoglycemic effect of metformin. Risk of hypoglycemia.
mech:berberina|antidiabeticos: Berberine activates AMPK (the same pathway as metformin), reduces gluconeogenesis, and improves glucose uptake.
effect:berberina|estatinas: Increases statin levels. Increased risk of myopathy/rhabdomyolysis.
mech:berberina|estatinas: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and the OATP1B1 transporter, reducing the clearance of simvastatin and atorvastatin.
effect:berberina|inmunosupresores: Significantly increases cyclosporine levels. Risk of nephrotoxicity.
mech:berberina|inmunosupresores: Inhibition of CYP3A4 and intestinal P-glycoprotein. Cyclosporine levels may double.
effect:berberina|anticoagulantes: May potentiate the anticoagulant effect by inhibiting CYP2C9.
mech:berberina|antihipertensivos: Berberine has its own vasodilatory effect and reduces peripheral resistance.
effect:berberina|antibioticos: May potentiate the efficacy of certain antibiotics (documented synergism).
mech:berberina|antibioticos: Berberine inhibits bacterial efflux pumps, improving antibiotic penetration.
effect:una_de_gato|anticoagulantes: Additive bleeding risk due to antiplatelet effect.
mech:una_de_gato|antihipertensivos: Rhynchophylline has a vasodilatory and antihypertensive effect.
mech:una_de_gato|inmunosupresores: Cat's claw stimulates the activity of NK cells and T lymphocytes.
effect:ayahuasca|isrs: Extreme risk of serotonin syndrome. Potentially fatal. Contraindicated combination.
mech:ayahuasca|isrs: Ayahuasca contains DMT (a 5-HT2A agonist) and β-carboline MAOIs. With SSRIs, serotonin reaches dangerous levels.
mech:ayahuasca|imao: Ayahuasca already contains MAOIs (harmine, harmaline). Adding more MAOIs is extremely dangerous.
effect:ayahuasca|opioides: Risk of serotonin crisis with tramadol (which has a serotonergic component).
mech:ayahuasca|opioides: Tramadol inhibits serotonin reuptake + β-carbolines are MAOIs = serotonin excess.
mech:ayahuasca|isrsn: Same mechanism as with SSRIs: β-carboline MAOIs + SNRI = serotonergic excess.
effect:espino_blanco|digoxina: Potentiates the effects of digoxin. Risk of digitalis toxicity (arrhythmias, nausea, yellow vision).
mech:espino_blanco|digoxina: Hawthorn flavonoids have a positive inotropic effect similar to that of digoxin.
effect:espino_blanco|antihipertensivos: Additive hypotensive effect. Risk of hypotension.
mech:espino_blanco|antihipertensivos: Hawthorn is a vasodilator and reduces peripheral resistance.
mech:espino_blanco|betabloqueantes: Additive negative inotropic and chronotropic effect.
effect:espino_blanco|antiarritmicos: Pharmacodynamic interaction with amiodarone and other antiarrhythmics.
mech:espino_blanco|antiarritmicos: Hawthorn modifies cardiac conductivity. Unpredictable additive effect.
effect:te_verde|anticoagulantes: Green tea contains vitamin K, which may antagonize warfarin. Large amounts reduce INR.
mech:te_verde|anticoagulantes: The vitamin K in green tea competes with warfarin's effect in the coagulation cascade.
effect:te_verde|estatinas: May increase simvastatin levels by inhibiting OATP1B1 and CYP3A4.
mech:te_verde|estatinas: EGCG inhibits the hepatic OATP1B1 transporter, reducing statin uptake.
effect:te_verde|antihipertensivos: May slightly potentiate the hypotensive effect.
mech:te_verde|antihipertensivos: EGCG has a vasodilatory effect mediated by nitric oxide.
effect:te_verde|betabloqueantes: May increase nadolol levels by inhibiting OATP-mediated absorption.
mech:te_verde|betabloqueantes: EGCG inhibits the intestinal OATP transporters that absorb nadolol.
effect:te_verde|tiroideos: Reduces levothyroxine absorption if taken together.
mech:te_verde|tiroideos: Green tea tannins chelate levothyroxine in the intestine, reducing its absorption.
effect:saw_palmetto|anticoagulantes: Reports of bleeding. Possible antiplatelet effect.
mech:saw_palmetto|anticoagulantes: Saw palmetto fatty acids may inhibit cyclooxygenase.
effect:saw_palmetto|anticonceptivos: Could theoretically interact with hormones due to its antiandrogenic effect.
mech:saw_palmetto|anticonceptivos: Saw palmetto inhibits 5-alpha reductase and may have hormonal effects.
effect:hoja_de_coca|imao: Risk of hypertensive crisis with MAOIs. The cocaine in the leaf (low concentration) blocks norepinephrine reuptake.
mech:hoja_de_coca|imao: Coca leaf contains traces of cocaine that block catecholamine reuptake. With MAOIs, catecholamines reach dangerous levels.
mech:hoja_de_coca|isrs: Cocaine inhibits serotonin reuptake. Although concentrations in the leaf are low, the combination requires caution.
effect:hoja_de_coca|antihipertensivos: May antagonize the hypotensive effect through vasoconstriction.
mech:hoja_de_coca|antihipertensivos: Coca alkaloids produce mild vasoconstriction and tachycardia.
effect:guarana|litio: Guarana's caffeine reduces lithium levels by increasing its renal excretion.
mech:guarana|litio: Caffeine is a weak diuretic. When stopped abruptly, lithium levels may rise to toxic ranges.
effect:guarana|benzodiacepinas: Caffeine antagonizes the sedative effect of benzodiazepines.
mech:guarana|benzodiacepinas: Caffeine blocks adenosine receptors, producing a stimulating effect that counteracts sedation.
effect:guarana|antihipertensivos: Caffeine may antagonize the hypotensive effect.
mech:guarana|antihipertensivos: Caffeine transiently increases blood pressure through vasoconstriction and catecholamine release.
effect:guarana|teofilina: Additive xanthine toxicity effect. Risk of arrhythmia and seizures.
mech:guarana|teofilina: Both caffeine and theophylline are methylxanthines that compete for CYP1A2.
effect:guayusa|litio: Same interaction as guarana — guayusa's caffeine reduces lithium levels.
mech:guayusa|litio: Guayusa contains caffeine in concentrations similar to coffee.
effect:melon_amargo|antidiabeticos: Significantly potentiates the hypoglycemic effect. Risk of severe hypoglycemia.
mech:melon_amargo|antidiabeticos: Bitter melon contains charantin and polypeptide-P that reduce glucose through pathways independent of metformin.
effect:melon_amargo|anticoagulantes: May have a mild antiplatelet effect.
mech:melon_amargo|anticoagulantes: Anti-inflammatory effect that may affect platelet function.
effect:graviola|antihipertensivos: May potentiate the hypotensive effect. Risk of hypotension.
mech:graviola|antihipertensivos: Graviola's acetogenins have a vasodilatory effect.
effect:graviola|antidiabeticos: May slightly potentiate the hypoglycemic effect.
mech:graviola|antidiabeticos: Annona muricata extracts reduce glucose in animal models.
effect:ashwagandha|tiroideos: May increase T3 and T4 levels. Risk of hyperthyroidism in medicated patients.
mech:ashwagandha|tiroideos: Ashwagandha directly stimulates thyroid hormone production.
effect:ashwagandha|benzodiacepinas: Potentiates the sedative effect. Risk of excessive drowsiness.
mech:ashwagandha|benzodiacepinas: Withanolides have a GABAergic effect that adds to that of benzodiazepines.
effect:ashwagandha|inmunosupresores: May antagonize immunosuppression. Ashwagandha is immunostimulant.
mech:ashwagandha|inmunosupresores: Withanolides activate macrophages, NK cells, and antibody production.
mech:ashwagandha|antidiabeticos: Clinical studies show a modest reduction in fasting glucose.
effect:ashwagandha|isrs: May potentiate the anxiolytic effect. Monitor.
mech:ashwagandha|isrs: Complementary anxiolytic effects through different pathways (GABA vs serotonin).
effect:cardo_mariano|estatinas: May increase statin levels. Increased risk of myopathy.
mech:cardo_mariano|estatinas: Silymarin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9. It also inhibits the OATP1B1 transporter.
effect:cardo_mariano|anticoagulantes: May increase warfarin levels by inhibiting CYP2C9.
effect:cardo_mariano|antidiabeticos: May potentiate the hypoglycemic effect of metformin.
mech:cardo_mariano|antidiabeticos: Silymarin improves insulin sensitivity and reduces glycosylated hemoglobin.
effect:cardo_mariano|quimioterapia: May alter the efficacy of chemotherapeutic agents metabolized by CYP3A4.
mech:cardo_mariano|quimioterapia: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase levels of irinotecan and other agents.
effect:cardo_mariano|inmunosupresores: May increase cyclosporine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 and P-gp.
mech:rhodiola|isrs: Rhodiola increases serotonin levels by inhibiting COMT and MAO.
effect:rhodiola|antidiabeticos: May slightly potentiate the hypoglycemic effect.
effect:rhodiola|benzodiacepinas: May antagonize sedation due to its adaptogenic/stimulant effect.
effect:regaliz|antihipertensivos: Licorice causes sodium retention and hypertension. It antagonizes antihypertensives.
mech:regaliz|antihipertensivos: Glycyrrhizic acid inhibits 11β-HSD2, increasing mineralocorticoid activity. It produces pseudohyperaldosteronism.
effect:regaliz|diureticos: Severe risk of hypokalemia with loop or thiazide diuretics.
mech:regaliz|diureticos: Licorice causes potassium loss through its mineralocorticoid effect. This adds to the effect of diuretics.
effect:regaliz|digoxina: Hypokalemia caused by licorice increases digoxin toxicity.
mech:regaliz|digoxina: Digoxin is more toxic with low potassium levels. Licorice causes potassium loss.
effect:regaliz|corticosteroides: May potentiate and prolong the effect of corticosteroids.
mech:regaliz|corticosteroides: Glycyrrhizic acid inhibits the enzyme that inactivates cortisol (11β-HSD2).
effect:regaliz|anticoagulantes: Theoretical interaction due to weak CYP2C9 inhibition.
effect:aloe_vera|antidiabeticos: May potentiate the hypoglycemic effect. Risk of hypoglycemia.
mech:aloe_vera|antidiabeticos: Aloe vera reduces fasting glucose in type 2 diabetics.
effect:aloe_vera|diureticos: Risk of hypokalemia with prolonged use of oral aloe vera (laxative effect).
mech:aloe_vera|diureticos: Aloe anthraquinones cause diarrhea with potassium loss. This adds to the effect of diuretics.
effect:aloe_vera|digoxina: Hypokalemia caused by oral aloe increases digoxin toxicity.
mech:aloe_vera|digoxina: Potassium loss due to laxative effect. Digoxin is more toxic with low K+.
effect:aloe_vera|corticosteroides: Additive risk of hypokalemia with corticosteroids.
mech:aloe_vera|corticosteroides: Both aloe (laxative) and corticosteroids cause potassium loss.
effect:pasiflora|benzodiacepinas: Potentiates sedation. Risk of excessive drowsiness.
mech:pasiflora|benzodiacepinas: Passionflower flavonoids (chrysin) are GABA-A receptor agonists.
effect:pasiflora|opioides: Potentiation of sedation and CNS depression.
effect:pasiflora|anestesicos: May prolong sedation. Consider discontinuing before surgery.
mech:melisa|benzodiacepinas: Lemon balm has a mild GABAergic effect.
effect:melisa|tiroideos: Lemon balm may interfere with thyroid function.
mech:melisa|tiroideos: Melissa officinalis extracts inhibit TSH binding to its receptor in vitro.
mech:tilo|benzodiacepinas: Linden has a mild sedative effect.
effect:tilo|litio: Linden's mild diuretic effect may affect lithium levels.
mech:tilo|litio: Diuretic effect may alter renal lithium reabsorption.
effect:cimicifuga|estatinas: Additive hepatotoxicity. Risk of liver damage.
mech:cimicifuga|estatinas: Black cohosh has reports of hepatotoxicity. Combined with hepatotoxic statins, the risk increases.
effect:cimicifuga|anticonceptivos: Theoretical interaction due to estrogenic effect.
mech:cimicifuga|anticonceptivos: Black cohosh has affinity for estrogen receptors, although its exact mechanism is debated.
effect:dong_quai|anticoagulantes: Significantly increases INR with warfarin. Bleeding reported.
mech:dong_quai|anticoagulantes: Dong quai contains natural coumarins that potentiate the anticoagulant effect.
mech:dong_quai|antiplaquetarios: Dong quai's coumarins plus the antiplatelet effect = synergistic bleeding.
effect:onagra|anticoagulantes: May potentiate the anticoagulant effect. Risk of bleeding.
effect:onagra|anticonvulsivantes: May lower the seizure threshold. Reported in epileptics.
mech:onagra|anticonvulsivantes: Mechanism not fully characterized, but reported in schizophrenic patients with epilepsy.
effect:fenogreco|antidiabeticos: Potentiates the hypoglycemic effect. Risk of hypoglycemia.
mech:fenogreco|antidiabeticos: The soluble fibers and 4-hydroxyisoleucine in fenugreek stimulate insulin secretion.
effect:fenogreco|anticoagulantes: Contains coumarins that may potentiate the anticoagulant effect.
mech:fenogreco|anticoagulantes: Fenugreek coumarins compete with vitamin K.
mech:fenogreco|tiroideos: High fiber content may reduce the absorption of oral medications.
effect:lino|anticoagulantes: The omega-3 in flaxseed may potentiate the anticoagulant effect.
mech:lino|antidiabeticos: Flaxseed lignans and soluble fiber slow carbohydrate absorption.
mech:canela|antidiabeticos: Cinnamon improves insulin sensitivity and reduces fasting glucose.
effect:canela|anticoagulantes: Cassia cinnamon contains coumarin that may interact with warfarin.
mech:canela|anticoagulantes: The coumarin in Cinnamomum cassia is a natural coumarin metabolized by CYP2A6.
effect:omega_3|anticoagulantes: High doses (>3 g/day) potentiate the anticoagulant effect. Increased bleeding risk.
mech:omega_3|anticoagulantes: Omega-3 fatty acids reduce thromboxane A2 production and platelet aggregation.
mech:omega_3|antiplaquetarios: EPA/DHA inhibits platelet activation via a pathway independent of aspirin.
effect:omega_3|antihipertensivos: May slightly potentiate the antihypertensive effect.
mech:omega_3|antihipertensivos: Omega-3 reduces systolic blood pressure by ~2-3 mmHg.
effect:coq10|anticoagulantes: CoQ10 has a structure similar to vitamin K2. May reduce the effect of warfarin.
mech:coq10|anticoagulantes: CoQ10 (ubiquinone) is structurally similar to vitamin K and may promote coagulation.
effect:coq10|antihipertensivos: May slightly potentiate the antihypertensive effect.
mech:coq10|antihipertensivos: CoQ10 reduces systolic blood pressure in meta-analyses.
effect:coq10|estatinas: Beneficial interaction: statins reduce CoQ10 levels. Supplementation may be protective.
mech:coq10|estatinas: Statins inhibit mevalonate synthesis, a precursor of both cholesterol and CoQ10.
mech:coq10|antidiabeticos: CoQ10 improves mitochondrial function in pancreatic beta cells.
effect:coq10|quimioterapia: May protect against doxorubicin cardiotoxicity. Consult with an oncologist.
mech:coq10|quimioterapia: CoQ10 is a mitochondrial antioxidant that may reduce cardiac damage from doxorubicin.
effect:melatonina|anticoagulantes: May slightly potentiate the anticoagulant effect.
mech:melatonina|anticoagulantes: Melatonin has a mild antiplatelet effect.
effect:melatonina|benzodiacepinas: Potentiates sedation. May allow reducing benzodiazepine doses.
mech:melatonina|benzodiacepinas: Additive sedative effects through different mechanisms (MT1/MT2 vs GABA-A).
effect:melatonina|antihipertensivos: Nighttime melatonin reduces blood pressure. Additive effect.
mech:melatonina|antihipertensivos: Melatonin has a vasodilatory effect and reduces nighttime blood pressure.
effect:melatonina|antidiabeticos: May affect glucose metabolism. Mixed evidence.
mech:melatonina|antidiabeticos: Melatonin modulates insulin secretion via MT1/MT2 receptors in beta cells.
mech:melatonina|isrs: SSRIs increase serotonin, a melatonin precursor. There may be additive drowsiness.
effect:melatonina|inmunosupresores: Melatonin is immunomodulatory. Theoretically it could affect immunosuppression.
mech:melatonina|inmunosupresores: Melatonin activates T helper lymphocytes and increases IL-2 and IFN-γ production.
effect:vitamina_k|anticoagulantes: Vitamin K significantly reduces the efficacy of warfarin and other coumarins.
mech:vitamina_k|anticoagulantes: Vitamin K is a cofactor for carboxylation of coagulation factors II, VII, IX, and X. It directly competes with warfarin's mechanism of action.
effect:5htp|isrs: Risk of serotonin syndrome. Dangerous combination.
mech:5htp|isrs: 5-HTP is converted directly into serotonin. With SSRIs (which block reuptake), serotonin levels can become excessive.
effect:5htp|imao: Contraindicated. Extreme risk of serotonin syndrome.
mech:5htp|imao: 5-HTP is converted into serotonin that cannot be degraded by the inhibited MAO.
effect:5htp|isrsn: Risk of serotonin syndrome. Same as with SSRIs.
mech:5htp|isrsn: 5-HTP increases available serotonin; SNRIs block its reuptake.
effect:5htp|opioides: Risk of serotonin syndrome with tramadol.
mech:5htp|opioides: Tramadol has a serotonergic component. With 5-HTP, excess serotonin.
effect:moringa|antidiabeticos: May potentiate the hypoglycemic effect. Monitor glucose.
effect:moringa|antihipertensivos: May slightly potentiate the antihypertensive effect.
mech:moringa|antihipertensivos: Moringa extracts have a vasodilatory effect.
effect:moringa|tiroideos: May affect thyroid function. Caution in treated hypothyroidism.
mech:moringa|tiroideos: Moringa contains isothiocyanates that are potential goitrogens.
effect:noni|anticoagulantes: Noni contains vitamin K, which may reduce the effect of warfarin.
mech:noni|anticoagulantes: The high vitamin K content of noni juice antagonizes warfarin.
effect:hierro_supl|tiroideos: Reduces levothyroxine absorption if taken together. Separate by at least 4 hours.
mech:hierro_supl|tiroideos: Iron forms insoluble complexes with levothyroxine in the intestine.
effect:hierro_supl|antibioticos: Reduces the absorption of ciprofloxacin, tetracyclines, and doxycycline. Separate by 2-4 hours.
mech:hierro_supl|antibioticos: Iron chelates fluoroquinolones and tetracyclines, reducing their absorption by >50%.
effect:hierro_supl|omeprazol: PPIs reduce iron absorption by raising gastric pH.
mech:hierro_supl|omeprazol: Non-heme iron requires an acidic environment for absorption. PPIs reduce gastric acid.
effect:magnesio|antibioticos: Reduces the absorption of fluoroquinolones and tetracyclines. Separate by 2-4 hours.
effect:magnesio|diureticos: Loop and thiazide diuretics increase urinary magnesium loss.
effect:magnesio|tiroideos: Reduces levothyroxine absorption. Separate by at least 4 hours.
mech:magnesio|tiroideos: Magnesium binds to levothyroxine in the intestine.
